_comment: Tier 7 (schema sensitivity) variant: SAME MEANING as questions_schema.json, reworded. coreSkillDepth here has a 6th level added and level wording changed; seniorityFit reworded; hasShippedProduction reworded. Used only by cases with schema_ref set. Compare results against the base schema to measure brittleness.

coreSkillDepth.instructions: Assess how deeply the candidate has actually applied the role's essential skills, weighting demonstrated project work over self-reported claims.
criteria: The required skills are entirely absent from the portfolio
The skills appear only as claims, with no supporting project
At least one project genuinely uses the skills
Several projects make real use of the skills
The candidate has owned production systems built on these skills
The candidate has led or architected significant production systems on these skills

seniorityFit.instructions: Compared with the seniority the role requires, how does this candidate's level compare?

criteria.over: Well beyond the role; might decline it

hasShippedProduction.instructions: Has the candidate shipped software that served real users beyond their immediate team, in a live production setting?
